#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct Item {
    pub identity: String,
    pub parent: String,
    pub kind: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub file: String,
    pub start: usize,
    pub end: usize,
    pub name_start: usize,
    pub name_end: usize,
    pub body: Option<(usize, usize)>,
    /// Defining struct for a validated generated projection; no authored bytes.
    pub generated_from: String,
    pub signature: String,
    pub text: String,
    pub type_name: String,
    pub type_resolved: bool,
    pub file_digest: String,
    pub text_digest: String,
    pub signature_digest: String,
    pub body_digest: String,
    pub references_complete: bool,
}

pub struct Catalog {
    pub root: String,
    pub module_sources: Vec<ModuleSource>,
    /// Whether reference discovery was requested; false is declarations-only.
    pub references_recorded: bool,
    pub items: Vec<Item>,
    pub by_identity: BTreeMap<String, usize>,
    pub references: Vec<Reference>,
    /// Semantic edges from validated expansions, never editable spelling sites.
    pub generated_references: Vec<Reference>,
    pub unresolved: Vec<Reference>,
    /// Resolved frontend expression types; None is unavailable or ambiguous.
    pub expression_types: BTreeMap<(String, usize, usize), Option<String>>,
    pub function_ids: Vec<String>,
    pub instance_ids: Vec<String>,
    pub instance_sources: Vec<String>,
    pub instance_arguments: Vec<String>,
    pub input_digest: String,
    pub implementations: Vec<(String, String, String)>,
}
